newsitem.title: USA: Strouds Inc Feb same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Strouds Inc Feb same-store sales down.

text.p: Strouds Inc on Thursday reported lower same-store sales.
The retailer posted net sales of about $14.3 million for the four week period ended March 1, 1997, compared with about $17.0 million for the five week February period last year.
Adjusting for the extra week last year, comparable store sales for the February 1997 period decreased 9.1 percent compared with the February period last year, it said.

Net sales for the 52 weeks ended March 1, 1997 were about $209.8 million compared with about $190.3 million for the 53 week period last year. Adjusting for the extra week last year, comparable store sales for the year increased 0.1 percent, it said.
